name: 04654 · Machias, ME
findings: ZIP 04654 (Machias) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 04654 (Machias) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 04654 (Machias) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
